fact_previews: ZX***学院 provides educational operation services and related educational equipment products for applied undergraduate and higher vocational colleges.
The core of the educational operation service is the construction of 'industry colleges' in collaboration with domestic universities.
The company is responsible for providing a comprehensive package of educational operation services for the 'industry colleges', including teaching management and curriculum development.
The sales of educational equipment products are based on the practical teaching needs of the colleges.
ZX***学院 has the capability to build large-scale bases for internships, training, and employment.
